observation: Captured via corrected precompileProbe hook on ship_pelican (draws 33/33/33, radius 10.39, size 12.49 x 11.75 x 11.75 WU, 0 errors). buildMiner (+X forward) combines a short chunky body/bow slab with an enormous 8-sided cylinder miner:mount (radius 0.34..0.40 * R) on the nose, small side scoop arms (miner:arm0, miner:scoop), dorsal miner:mach block, and recessedCanopy. In close and inspect: (1) miner:mount renders as a giant blunt flat-faced octagonal barrel nearly as wide as the main body, with no drill bit when fittings omit mining (making the prow look like an oversized unfinished plug); (2) recessedCanopy is an oversized bulbous faceted dome covering the upper hull; (3) ship:dish clips into the aft edge of the canopy; (4) engineProp floats completely detached in empty space behind the stern; (5) small nose:panel flaps and surfaceDetail fins stick awkwardly off the flanks in inspect. Explicit lod2 was not captured.
decision: disposition: needs follow-up — oversized blunt 8-sided miner:mount drum dominating the nose without a seated drill assembly, bulbous oversized recessedCanopy bubble, clipping ship:dish, detached floating engineProp, and protruding nose:panel decals.
next: Sculpt an integrated mining prow/clamp collar that reads finished even without an equipped drill, scale down and recess recessedCanopy, flush-seat engineProp and ship:dish, verify lod2, and recapture.
